page.overview:
Who is Anglu?

Anglu was a Twi'lek who was a swoop pilot for the Hidden Beks. They attended the Tarisian Season Opener and talked to the former Sith Lord Revan there. They fled shortly thereafter when a fight broke out between Black Vulkar leader Brejik and Revan.

Anglu was a Twi'lek female who operated as a swoop pilot for the swoop gang Hidden Beks on the Outer Rim planet Taris during the Jedi Civil War During 3956 BBY, they attended the Tarisian Season Opener in which then amnesiac former Sith Lord Revan competed against the Black Vulkar swoop pilot Redros for Jedi Bastila Shan as a prize.

During the Season opener, Revan talked to Anglu, with them admitting to not understanding why new swoop riders make their starts in the biggest races of the year. Anglu then told Revan about his swoops chance to explode due to the prototype swoop accelerator installed on it.

After Revan won the swoop race, Black Vulkar leader Brejik accused Revan of cheating in the race. Cutting Brejik's boasting short, Shan was able to escape from the cage she was kept in and defeated the guard near her. Brejik called for Shan and Revan to killed and Anglu fled shortly thereafter.
